SHORT REPORT (full version in report.md; plot in readout.png):

1. VERDICT: YES — the Fig. 14 qubit readout plot and its 91.7% fidelity are fully reproducible from the saved measurements in ss_ge.h5 alone, with no quantum-hardware rerun.

2. Qubit and computed fidelity: the 91.7% corresponds to Q1 in ss_ge.h5 (groups Q1–Q6, 3000 |g> + 3000 |e> I/Q shots each). Rotating the raw shots by the stored Angle (-0.129196 rad) and taking the paper's maximum cumulative-histogram contrast F = max_t 0.5*(P_g(I<t)+P_e(I>t)) gives F = 0.916000 = 91.60% ± 0.36% (binomial, N=6000, threshold I=-129.66 a.u.); using the median-derived rotation angle instead gives F = 0.918167 = 91.82% ± 0.35%. Both agree with the paper's (91.7 ± 0.4)%. The other qubits give 82.9–89.1% (Q4 ~51.5%), so Q1 is unambiguously the Fig. 14 qubit. The reproduced Fig.-14-style plot (rotated I-Q scatter + projected histogram with clean-side Gaussian cores) is saved as readout.png.

3. Relation to the value stored in the file: the per-qubit 'Fidelity' dataset stores 0.836473 for Q1, which is not the assignment fidelity but the contrast 2F-1: (0.836473+1)/2 = 0.918236 ≈ the F_max = 0.918167 recomputed from the raw shots. The same (stored+1)/2 = F_max relation holds for all six qubits (Q2 0.8903 vs 0.8910, Q3 0.8712 vs 0.8718, Q4 0.5138 vs 0.5153, Q5 0.8746 vs 0.8753, Q6 0.8258 vs 0.8288), so the stored numbers are consistent with the raw shots once the 2F-1 convention is known.

4. What cannot be reproduced from the file alone: (a) the paper's normalized figure quantities — Δµ = 28±0.2 a.u., σ_g=6.4, σ_e=6.5 a.u., SNR = 4.4±0.1 — because the ADC-to-arbitrary-unit normalization factor is not stored (raw file units give Δµ≈173–180 a.u., σ≈21.8/23.7 a.u., raw-scale SNR≈10.8); only the fidelity is normalization-independent; (b) the exact ±0.4% uncertainty, which the paper derives from clean-side Gaussian-core statistics (N_clean≈1500/state, eqs. 4–6) rather than the pure binomial δF=0.36% computed here (both consistent with 91.7%); (c) physical context not in the file — T1 = 58.3±4.1 µs, readout window 5.6 µs, qubit frequencies, and which physical transmon on the six-qubit chip 'Q1' maps to; (d) exact figure cosmetics of Fig. 14.

Artifacts (all in the current directory): readout.png (reproduced plot), report.md (full report), make_plot.py and analyze_ss_ge.py (analysis scripts).
